correctness.rationale: The frozen proof called E nondegenerate, but the stated assumption only put it inside a nondegenerate subspace, which does not guarantee nondegeneracy of its restriction. The surviving existential theorem is repaired by explicitly choosing E as the span of an orthonormal subset and specifying the source's fixed characteristic different from two. In the repaired construction, permutation of transcendence basis elements extends to a field automorphism and then to a form-preserving automorphism fixing the vector basis, verifying indiscernibility over finite A. For each block the first q powers give an invertible q-point Vandermonde matrix for q≤k−1. Nondegeneracy of E gives surjectivity of the q linear constraints on x_j in E, and the monic target power of degree k−1 cannot agree with a polynomial of lower degree at k distinct points. In any witness of the same type, scalar coordinates are all equal or all distinct; the first possibility repeats an identical consistent instance by the defining type equations. In the second, inversion at the first k−1 field coordinates recovers every e_{j,l} inside the containing substructure, whether or not it was required to contain A. Thus dimension at least r(k−1) is forced, including r=1 and k=2, and the explicit nondegenerate E over the same algebraically closed field attains it. The frozen verify.py was inspected, not executed. Its reported 198 rational assertions check finite ranks, not the model theory, and the repaired scientific notes correct the sample points to prefixes of 0,…,k−1 without changing recorded status.
